prompts.Lian:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production transparent 2D battle sprite atlas for Requiem Lantern.
The input is an identity reference. Redesign this SAME adult character as a compact SD battle sprite, roughly 3 to 3.5 heads tall: noticeably enlarged head, short sturdy legs, readable hands and weapon. Mature dark fantasy anime game style, serious expression, crisp inked silhouettes, painterly restrained shading, matching all five party members. Preserve exact hair color/style, facial traits, costume colors/materials/accessories, and weapon identity from the reference. This is a NEW battle asset; do not produce the tall original proportions.
ONE landscape PNG, 1536 by 1024, invisible 3 columns by 2 rows of 512 square cells. Exactly six full-body drawings, one per cell, same body scale and same facing SCREEN RIGHT. Each standing body around 340 px tall, feet local x256 y465. Every part, hair, coat and weapon remains in its own cell with at least 20 transparent pixels separating all drawings. Uniform orthographic three-quarter side view and body scale. All six clearly different anatomical poses with a physically planted fighting motion.
Cell order reading left to right then next row: 0 guarded idle; 1 windup with arms drawn back and bent knees; 2 committed attack with arm/weapon reaching right toward contact at local x440 y270; 3 heavy followthrough stepping forward; 4 recovery returning to guard; 5 hit recoil leaning backward to left, guarding against hit from the right.
No text, grid lines, numbers, borders, other characters, background, floor, cast shadows, ghost limbs, motion trails, lasers, projectiles, decorative particles or glowing aura. Genuine transparent alpha outside the six silhouettes. No duplicate idle poses, no infant or toy-like body.
Character and poses: Lian: young silver bob-haired knight with amber and pale blue eyes, white/navy torn coat, black fitted suit, articulated steel armor and fine gold trim. Anatomical left hand bears the ornate oval steel/gold shield, right hand a short straight steel sword with gold hilt. Shield bash and sword slash, idle sword lowered, windup sword back, attack lunging sword forward, followthrough diagonal slash, recoil shield pushed up. Preserve reference shield design.
